  jobId: string
  userId: string
  productId: string
  sprintRunId: string
}): Promise<void> {

    where: { id: opts.sprintRunId },
    select: { status: true },
  })
  if (run?.status !== 'DONE') return

    prisma.product.findUnique({ where: { id: opts.productId }, select: { repo_url: true } }),
    prisma.claudeJob.findMany({
      where: { sprint_run_id: opts.sprintRunId, pr_url: { not: null } },
      orderBy: { created_at: 'asc' },
      select: { pr_url: true, head_sha: true, task: { select: { repo_url: true } } },
    }),
  ])
  const productPrJob = prJobs.find(
    (j) => repoBucketKey(j.task?.repo_url, product?.repo_url) === null,
  )
  if (!productPrJob?.pr_url) {
    console.warn(`[sprint-batch-deploy] geen product-repo-batch-PR voor sprint_run ${opts.sprintRunId}; auto-deploy overgeslagen`)
    return

  const prUrl = productPrJob.pr_url

  if (!headSha) {

  }
  if (!headSha) {

      body: (err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)).slice(0, 120),

      tag: `deploy-enqueue-${opts.jobId}`,
    })
  }
}
